scope: AgentBench alfworld/dbbench/webshop and TauBench airline/retail/telecom; OS excluded
optimizer_cost_scope: Only Evolve/Debugger or Meta optimization roles; exclude local Qwen solver and user simulator. Include failed, rejected and repair calls. Cached input is already part of input, not added again.

ahe.cost: partial measured Evolve tracing; full optimizer estimate uses user-approved mean 50000 tokens for untraced calls, label estimated
ahe.capability_profile: h2345-budget-restricted-v1, at most 10 detailed cases; not unrestricted reproduction

life.cost: recorded API usage; normalize inherited and failed/abandoned paid attempts per round, do not treat requalified zero-call rows as zero historical spend

meta_and_ahe.cost: recorded optimizer usage except one authorized reconstructed AHE Telecom call: 135307 estimated tokens; keep estimate separate

life_telecom.cost: recorded API usage, includes inherited first-round paid candidate and failed preflights

life_airline.cost: missing usable per-round external LLM tokens: legacy Qoder modelUsage/usage reported zeros; credits are not token counts

life_retail.note: Published 63% is one reference accuracy, not a six-round training/cost curve

plot_rules: Cumulative optimizer input+output tokens on x-axis; identify estimates explicitly.
Round training scores use rotating batches; not a fixed-task monotonic learning curve.
Final TEST accuracy is a separate TRAIN-selected endpoint, not six per-round TEST measurements.
AHE optimization_step 1 corresponds to native iteration 2; use COMPARISON_REFERENCE_CORRECTION.json, not frozen raw ahe_reference entries.
Do not rerun unrelated benchmarks just to fill the plot without user direction.
